questions.question: When four kings carried off the goods and food of Sodom, which relative of Abram did they also capture?
When Abram heard that kings had carried off captives from Sodom, what did he do with his 318 trained men?

answers.text: Set out in pursuit of the kings
Kept them guarding his tents at Mamre
Sent them with a ransom for the captives

questions.question: After Abram won a battle against four kings, who received a tenth of everything from him?
After rescuing Lot, why did Abram refuse to take even a thread from the king of Sodom?

answers.text: So the king could not say he made Abram rich
So the people of Sodom would trust him
So the four kings would not come back for it
